query:
-- Liaisons Rose de Damas (ghost_variety_id = 1) avec Géraniol
SELECT gvml.ghost_variety_id, gvml.molecule_id, gvml.link_type, gvml.percentage, m.name 
FROM ghost_variety_molecule_links gvml 
JOIN molecules m ON gvml.molecule_id = m.id 
WHERE gvml.ghost_variety_id = 1 
ORDER BY CAST(gvml.percentage AS DECIMAL) DESC
LIMIT 5;
